title: Fortuitous BMN Cohomology at Every $N$
summary: Finite-$N$ trace relations can produce $Q$-cohomology classes with no stable large-$N$ ancestor. The brane-fused construction at $SU(3)$ suggests that such states can retain an $SU(2)$ nonabelian core accompanied by scalar hair. We develop this idea into a general construction for every $SU(N)$, $N\geq3$. Starting from the $SU(2)$ threshold operator $O_{24}$, we select pairs of eigenvalues of one scalar and construct corrected two-colour letters whose $Q$-transformations obey the $SU(2)$ rules exactly.
